\item \textit{Note:} Empirical CRPS scores the equally weighted empirical predictive distribution; adjusted denotes the pairwise correction under independent, identically distributed predictive draws. Scores use $\log(1+x)$ discharge, with $x$ in m$^3$/s. For physical ensemble members, independence is a sensitivity assumption. Sample counts are 2,000 for AL/exAL, 64 for N-U-T1 and 48 for N-M-T0/T1; GloFAS and NWS contain 51 and seven members. The adjustment is inapplicable to deterministic climatology and EMOS grids and to the persistence point mass; adjusted skill is not reported. N, AL and exAL denote normal, asymmetric Laplace and extended asymmetric Laplace likelihoods. U and M denote one and multiple observation sources; T1 retains the transfer contribution at forecast leads and T0 omits it.
